questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, the two symbols move one position clockwise around four corners.
Row 1 left: ○ top-left; □ bottom-right
Row 1 right: ○ top-right; □ bottom-left
Row 2 left: △ top-right; ◇ bottom-left
Row 2 right: ?

choices.A: △ top-right; ◇ bottom-left
choices.B: △ top-left; ◇ bottom-right
choices.C: △ bottom-left; ◇ top-right

questions.correctAnswer: △ bottom-right; ◇ top-left
questions.explanation: One clockwise corner move sends △ to bottom-right and ◇ to top-left.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Down each column, the lower cell adds an outer square around the symbol.
Top-left: ○
Bottom-left: ○ inside □
Top-right: △
Bottom-right: ?

choices.A: □ inside △
choices.B: △ beside □
choices.C: ▲ inside □

questions.correctAnswer: △ inside □
questions.explanation: The open triangle remains unchanged and gains an outer square.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. In each row, the right cell changes + to × and duplicates the shape.
Row 1: ○ + | ○ ○ ×
Row 2: □ + | ?
questions.explanation: The square is duplicated and + changes to ×.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, the line is reflected left-to-right while the shape changes from open to filled.
Row 1: / ○ | \ ●
Row 2: \ □ | ?
questions.explanation: A left-right reflection changes \ to /, and open □ becomes filled ■.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. The third cell shows the symbol that appears most often in the first two groups.
Row 1: ○ ○ □ | ○ △ | ○
Row 2: + ★ ★ | ★ × | ?
questions.explanation: ★ appears three times across the two groups, more often than + or ×.

questions.prompt: A square is folded from left to right. A hole is punched near the folded paper’s top edge and another near its bottom edge, at different horizontal positions. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes in one vertical line
choices.B: Eight holes around the edges
choices.C: Four holes in one vertical column
choices.D: Four holes forming two horizontal mirrored pairs

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes forming two horizontal mirrored pairs
questions.explanation: Each punch reflects horizontally, giving two mirrored pairs and four holes.

questions.prompt: A rectangle is folded from top to bottom and then left to right. A hole is punched near the folded paper’s lower-right area, away from edges. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes on the right
choices.B: Four holes in one horizontal row
choices.C: Four holes in corresponding positions across both centerlines

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes in corresponding positions across both centerlines
questions.explanation: Two perpendicular folds produce four positions reflected across both centerlines.

questions.prompt: A square is folded along the diagonal from lower-left to upper-right. A small triangular cut is made on the folded diagonal edge, away from corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two triangular cuts on outer edges
choices.B: One symmetric diamond-shaped opening centered on the diagonal
choices.C: One triangular cut on the diagonal

questions.correctAnswer: One symmetric diamond-shaped opening centered on the diagonal
questions.explanation: The triangular cut on the fold reflects to form one symmetric diamond-like opening.

questions.prompt: A square is folded from bottom to top. Three holes are punched in a horizontal row on the folded paper, away from edges. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Six holes in one horizontal row
choices.B: Three holes on the horizontal centerline
choices.C: Six holes forming three vertical mirrored pairs

questions.correctAnswer: Six holes forming three vertical mirrored pairs
questions.explanation: Each punch reflects vertically, producing three vertical pairs and six holes.

questions.prompt:
The following groups share one rule:
1. ○ □ ●
2. △ ◇ ▲
3. ☆ ○ ★
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Each group has two different open shapes followed by the filled version of the first shape.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements share one rule:
1. Left +; center ○; right +
2. Left ×; center □; right ×
3. Left ★; center △; right ★
Which choice follows the same rule?

choices.A: Left ◇; center ☆; right ◇
choices.B: Left ○; center +; right ○
choices.C: Left +; center ■; right +

questions.correctAnswer: Left ◇; center ☆; right ◇
questions.explanation: Matching outer symbols surround a different open center shape.

questions.prompt:
The following figures share one rule:
1. Outer ○; inner + at top
2. Outer □; inner × at top
3. Outer △; inner ★ at top
Which choice follows the same rule?

choices.A: Outer ◇; inner ○ at top
choices.B: Outer ◇; inner ○ at bottom
choices.C: Outer ◇; inner ◆ at top

questions.correctAnswer: Outer ◇; inner ○ at top
questions.explanation: An open outer shape contains a different symbol positioned at the top.

questions.prompt:
Complete the 2 × 2 matrix.
Top-left: ○ | ▲
Top-right: ▲ | ●
Bottom-left: □ | ◆
Bottom-right: ?
Across each row, the right symbol of a cell becomes the left symbol of the next cell, and the new right symbol is the filled form of the previous cell's left symbol. Which cell completes the matrix?
questions.explanation: The prior right symbol moves left, while the filled version of the prior left symbol moves right.

questions.prompt:
Complete the 2 × 2 matrix.
Top-left: ↑ ○
Top-right: ○ →
Bottom-left: ↓ □
Bottom-right: ?
Across a row, the arrow moves from before the shape to after it and rotates 90° clockwise. The shape stays the same. Which cell completes the matrix?
questions.explanation: The arrow shifts behind the unchanged square and rotates clockwise from down to left.

questions.prompt:
Complete the 2 × 2 matrix.
Top-left: ○ + □
Top-right: ○ □ +
Bottom-left: △ + ◇
Bottom-right: ?
Across each row, the middle symbol moves to the far right while the other two remain in order. Which cell completes the matrix?
questions.explanation: Moving the middle plus sign to the end leaves the triangle and diamond in their original order.

questions.prompt:
Complete the 2 × 2 matrix.
Top-left: Top ○; Bottom ■
Top-right: Top ■; Bottom ○
Bottom-left: Top △; Bottom ◆
Bottom-right: ?
Across each row, the two symbols exchange vertical positions. Which cell completes the matrix?

choices.A: Top ◆; Bottom △
choices.B: Top △; Bottom ◆
choices.C: Top ▲; Bottom ◇

questions.correctAnswer: Top ◆; Bottom △
questions.explanation: As in the top row, the two symbols exchange their upper and lower positions.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded along the diagonal from upper-left to lower-right so the lower-left half lies over the upper-right half. A triangular notch is cut from the folded edge halfway between the upper-left and lower-right corners, not at either endpoint. What appears after the sheet is fully unfolded?

choices.A: One triangular notch on the outer left edge
choices.B: Two triangular notches mirrored across the other diagonal
choices.C: Two triangular cutouts mirrored across the fold diagonal
choices.D: Four triangular cutouts arranged around the center

questions.correctAnswer: Two triangular cutouts mirrored across the fold diagonal
questions.explanation: Unfolding reflects the cut across the single diagonal fold, creating two symmetric cutouts.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded from bottom to top along the horizontal centerline. The folded rectangle is then folded from right to left along its vertical centerline. One hole is punched exactly at the upper-left corner of the final folded rectangle. Where will the holes appear after full unfolding?

choices.A: At the centers of the four quarters
choices.B: At four locations meeting at the original sheet's center
choices.C: At the midpoint of the top and bottom edges only
choices.D: At the four outer corners of the original sheet

questions.correctAnswer: At the four outer corners of the original sheet
questions.explanation: The final folded upper-left corner maps through the two centerline reflections to all four original outer corners.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded from left to right along the vertical centerline. One circular hole is punched on the top edge of the folded rectangle, halfway between its left and right edges. After unfolding, what is the result?

choices.A: One hole at the midpoint of the square's top edge
choices.B: Two holes on the bottom edge
choices.C: Two holes on the top edge, equally spaced from the vertical centerline
choices.D: Four holes, one near each corner

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes on the top edge, equally spaced from the vertical centerline
questions.explanation: The vertical fold reflects the punch to a second top-edge position at the same distance from the centerline.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet that is twice as wide as it is tall is folded from left to right along the vertical centerline, forming a square. The square is then folded along the diagonal from its upper-left corner to its lower-right corner. A hole is punched inside the final folded shape at a point not on either fold. What must be true after full unfolding?

choices.A: Exactly two holes appear, both above the horizontal centerline.
choices.B: Exactly eight holes appear around the outer edge.
choices.C: Exactly six holes appear along one diagonal.
choices.D: Exactly four holes appear, related by the two fold reflections.

questions.correctAnswer: Exactly four holes appear, related by the two fold reflections.
questions.explanation: An interior punch off both folds doubles with each of the two reflections, producing four related locations.

questions.explanation: Each group has matching open outer shapes surrounding a different filled center shape.

questions.explanation: Like each example, this group places an open shape left and its filled counterpart right.

choices.B: Top: ◇; Center: ◇; Bottom: -
choices.C: Top: ◆; Center: -; Bottom: ◇

questions.explanation: Matching open shapes occupy the top and bottom positions around a different central symbol.

Top-right: □

Bottom-right: ?

questions.explanation: Removing the repeated pair of diamonds leaves the single triangle.

questions.prompt:
Complete the 2 × 2 matrix.

Top-right: Top-right →; Bottom-left ○
Bottom-left: Bottom-left ←; Top-right □

choices.A: Top-left ↓; Bottom-right □
choices.B: Top-right ↑; Bottom-left □
choices.C: Top-left ↑; Bottom-right □

questions.correctAnswer: Top-left ↑; Bottom-right □
questions.explanation: The arrow moves clockwise to the top-left and rotates from left to up, while the square moves counterclockwise to bottom-right.

questions.prompt:

Top-left: ○
Top-right: ○ ○
Bottom-left: ▲ ▲
Bottom-right: ?
Across each row, one matching shape is added. Down each column, open circles become filled triangles and the count doubles. Which cell completes the matrix?
questions.explanation: The top-right count of two doubles down the column, producing four filled triangles.

questions.prompt:
Complete the 2 × 2 matrix.
Top-left: ○ inside □
Top-right: □ inside ○
Bottom-left: △ inside ◇
Bottom-right: ?
Across each row, the inner and outer shapes exchange places without changing fill. Which cell completes the matrix?

choices.A: △ beside ◇
choices.B: ◇ inside △
choices.C: ▲ inside ◆

questions.correctAnswer: ◇ inside △
questions.explanation: Exchanging the inner triangle and outer diamond places the diamond inside the triangle.

questions.prompt:
Complete the 3 × 3 matrix.
Row 1: ○ □ | □ △ | ○ △
Row 2: ▲ ◆ | ◆ ★ | ▲ ★
Row 3: Cell 1: + ×; Cell 2: × |; Cell 3: ?
In each row, the symbol appearing in both of the first two cells is removed; the third cell contains the two remaining symbols in order. Which cell completes the matrix?
questions.explanation: The repeated multiplication sign is removed, leaving the plus sign followed by the vertical line.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded from left to right along the vertical centerline and then from bottom to top along the horizontal centerline. The resulting small square is folded along its diagonal from upper-left to lower-right. One hole is punched inside the final folded shape, away from folds and edges. After full unfolding, what appears?

choices.A: Six holes arranged along the diagonal
choices.B: Four holes related only by the centerline folds
choices.C: Eight holes related by three fold reflections
choices.D: Two holes on opposite sides of the diagonal

questions.correctAnswer: Eight holes related by three fold reflections
questions.explanation: Each of three folds doubles an off-fold interior punch, producing 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 holes.

questions.prompt: A circular sheet is folded in half from left to right along a vertical diameter. A small semicircular notch is cut from the curved outer edge of the folded sheet, above the horizontal center. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: One circular hole at the center
choices.B: Two matching notches on the curved edge, mirrored across the vertical diameter
choices.C: Two holes on the vertical diameter
choices.D: Four matching notches equally spaced around the edge

questions.correctAnswer: Two matching notches on the curved edge, mirrored across the vertical diameter
questions.explanation: Reversing the single fold reflects the notch to the opposite side of the circle's curved edge.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded from top to bottom along the horizontal centerline. A hole is punched exactly on the folded sheet's vertical centerline and below the fold, not on an outer edge. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes on the vertical centerline, mirrored across the horizontal centerline
choices.B: Two holes on the horizontal centerline
choices.C: One hole above the horizontal centerline
choices.D: Four holes mirrored across both centerlines

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes on the vertical centerline, mirrored across the horizontal centerline
questions.explanation: The horizontal fold doubles the hole, while its position on the vertical centerline remains unchanged.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded along the diagonal from upper-right to lower-left. The resulting right isosceles triangle is folded along its line of symmetry so that its two acute corners meet. A hole is punched inside the final folded shape, away from folds and edges. How many holes appear after full unfolding?
questions.explanation: Each of the two folds doubles an interior off-fold punch, producing 2 × 2 = 4 holes.

choices.B: Top-left: ◆; Top-right: ▲; Bottom: △
choices.C: Top-left: □; Top-right: ▲; Bottom: △

choices.B: Top: □ ◇; Bottom: ◆ ■

Row 2: Cell 1: ▲ ◆; Cell 2: ◆ ★; Cell 3: ▲ ◆ ★

Bottom-left: △ | ◇
Bottom-right: ?
Across each row, each symbol advances one place in this cycle: ○, □, △, ◇, ☆. Which cell completes the matrix?
questions.explanation: Advancing the triangle and diamond one place in the stated cycle produces diamond and star.

questions.explanation: Removing one of three open squares leaves two shapes, and changing fill produces two filled squares.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is divided conceptually into three equal vertical panels. The left panel is folded rightward over the center panel, and the right panel is then folded leftward over the center panel. One hole is punched inside the final stack, away from folds and edges. What appears after full unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes mirrored across one fold
choices.B: Four holes arranged around the center
choices.C: Three holes, one in each vertical panel at matching heights

questions.correctAnswer: Three holes, one in each vertical panel at matching heights
questions.explanation: The three stacked panels separate during unfolding, placing one corresponding hole in each panel.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded from bottom to top along the horizontal centerline. A V-shaped notch is cut from the folded sheet's left outer edge, above the fold. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: One notch on the left edge
choices.B: Two matching notches on the left edge, mirrored across the horizontal centerline
choices.C: Four notches, one on each edge
choices.D: Two notches on the top and bottom edges

questions.correctAnswer: Two matching notches on the left edge, mirrored across the horizontal centerline
questions.explanation: Reversing the horizontal fold reflects the edge notch to a second position on the same outer edge.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded along the diagonal from lower-left to upper-right. One hole is punched exactly on the folded diagonal, away from the corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: One hole located on the diagonal fold line
choices.B: Two holes mirrored across the diagonal
choices.C: Four holes around the center
choices.D: One hole on an outer edge

questions.correctAnswer: One hole located on the diagonal fold line
questions.explanation: A punch exactly on a fold maps onto itself when the sheet is reopened.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded from left to right along the vertical centerline. Two holes are punched inside the folded rectangle at different heights and different distances from the fold, with neither hole on a fold or edge. How many holes appear after unfolding?
questions.explanation: Each off-fold punch reflects once across the vertical centerline, so two punches produce four holes.
